Loupe's avatar. The first letter of a name, or an icon, in a disc or a rounded square. A dot shows a connection.

```jsx
<Avatar variant="accent">Example</Avatar>
<Avatar variant="tint">Example</Avatar>
<Avatar variant="ink">Example</Avatar>
<Avatar variant="danger">Example</Avatar>
<Avatar variant="chrome">Example</Avatar>
```

Variants: `accent`, `tint`, `ink`, `danger`, `chrome`. Sizes: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-avatar` classes of the app.
